Market today: The mood is sour, driven by anxiety around software and chip sector news. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, is feeling the pinch.

Your holdings: SMCI (-45.67%), SOXL (-79.84%), and MU (-64.05%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on AMD's reaction to the short-seller report and any fallout from the Nvidia subpoena.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your most painful, leveraged positions and the broader chip sector sentiment.
plays: Trim SOXL if it breaks below 45.30, given its deep losses and leveraged nature.
Consider trimming SMCI if it shows no immediate bounce from its current low.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
